annotation.title_clean: Yükseköğretim Kurumları Bilimsel Araştırma ve Yayın Faaliyetlerinde Üretken Yapay Zekâ Kullanımına Dair Etik Rehber
annotation.title_en: Ethical Guide on the Use of Generative AI in Scientific Research and Publication Activities of Higher Education Institutions
named_instruments_referenced: Turkey Law on Intellectual and Artistic Works No. 5846
annotation.summary_en: Turkish Council of Higher Education (YÖK) ethical guide (May 2024) on using generative AI in research and publication. It sets values (transparency, integrity, diligence, fairness, privacy, accountability), warns of hallucination, bias and IP risks, requires disclosure of AI use, and notes Turkey has no AI-specific legislation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Researchers bear legal and ethical responsibility for all AI-generated content.
AI use must be disclosed, including tool, version and stage, in the methods section.
AI should not replace higher-order tasks such as hypothesis development and interpretation.
Ethics committee applications should state the purpose and scope of generative AI use.
Turkey has no AI-specific law; KVKK, Higher Education Law and copyright law apply.
